capabilities: copy selected text as plain text via context menu or command palette
strip Markdown syntax with a regex-based Super Simple mode
parse and strip Markdown with a Unified/Remark AST pipeline
toggle stripping of specific elements like tables, math, footnotes and frontmatter
extras: README warns that AST-based stripping can be slow on very large selections and that Simple Mode must be disabled for advanced settings to apply.
problem: Copying text from Obsidian keeps Markdown syntax like headings, emphasis, links and tables, which clutters text pasted into other apps.
summary: Plain-text copy tool that strips Markdown from selected note text via a context-menu or command-palette command, with tunable stripping options.
